stage0250_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ Earth Federation Forces HQ, $$プリベンター$$ HQ ～

stage0250_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$サイガス$$
「The battle with Neo Zeon
　continues to swing back and forth. It is fair to say
　the war has reached a stalemate.」

stage0250_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$サイガス$$
「To break this stalemate,
　you will deploy $c to the front.」

stage0250_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$レディ$$
「I believe I have already refused that request.」

stage0250_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$レディ$$
「$c is an independent unit under the $$大統領$$,
　working for the peace and progress of all humanity.」

stage0250_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$サイガス$$
「That makes it all the more vital to crush Neo Zeon!」

stage0250_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$レディ$$
「Naturally, ending the war quickly is also important.
　But as you know, this war is being steered
　according to one person's specific designs.」

stage0250_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$レディ$$
「$c is assigned to pursue them.」

stage0250_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$サイガス$$
「At this stage, what started it hardly matters!
　What matters is victory!」

stage0250_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$レディ$$
「You know how little time remains until $$エタニティ・フラット$$,
　yet you still intend to fight?」

stage0250_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Tell that to $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　The $$大統領$$ told him the truth,
　yet he shows no desire for a ceasefire!」

stage0250_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Then neither can we afford to back down!」

stage0250_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$レディ$$
「Do you understand how many lives
　will be sacrificed over such a petty battle
　of wills?」

stage0250_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$サイガス$$
「If you insist on defying Supreme Command,
　then I have measures of my own.」

stage0250_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$レディ$$
「Are you saying Chrono has that much power?」

stage0250_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$レディ$$
「We already know that behind you...
　no, behind the Earth supremacists, stands
　an organization known as Chrono.」

stage0250_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$レディ$$
「And that Chrono has some connection
　to humanity's enemy, Geminis.」

stage0250_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$サイガス$$
「...Do you think you have won, $$レディ・アン$$?」

stage0250_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$レディ$$
「This is not a matter of winning or losing.」

stage0250_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$サイガス$$
「Very well...!
　I will withdraw for today!」

stage0250_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$サイガス$$
「But remember this!
　Chrono watches over humanity's evolution.
　To defy its will is to betray all humanity!」

stage0250_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$サイガス$$
「You will regret this someday!」

stage0250_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$レディ$$
（Information from $$ゼロ$$...
　It appears to be true.）

stage0250_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$レディ$$
（But all we have uncovered is the name Chrono...
　We know nothing of its members, scale, or purpose...）

stage0250_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$レディ$$
（Geminis and Chrono...
　And Neo Zeon...
　It seems I must call on $c again...）

stage0250_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「...$$スザク$$ and I investigated sites
　where Geminis had operated and found people
　who had clearly aided them.」

stage0250_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Are you saying those people belong to Chrono?」

stage0250_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「More precisely, they were several layers removed,
　subordinates to subordinates of people who received
　orders from Chrono.」

stage0250_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「They were mere pawns, barely aware of the meaning
　or purpose of their actions. But tracing their orders
　always led to a dead end.」

stage0250_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Exactly.
　Its scale and purpose are unknown, but it appears
　to wield influence in politics, economics, and war.」

stage0250_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It also has enough power
　to conceal its existence so thoroughly.」

stage0250_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It would seem so.
　Even $$ミスリル$$ failed to discover its existence.」

stage0250_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Mr. $$ゼロ$$.
　You have my sincere respect for your skill.」

stage0250_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「For the sake of my pride, let me be clear.
　I achieved this without using 《$$ギアス$$》.」

stage0250_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I did employ a measure of strategy,
　but this was all the fruit of steady, precise inquiry.」

stage0250_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I know, $$ゼロ$$.
　You will never use that power again.」

stage0250_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Thus the task took time.
　I apologize for joining $c so late.」

stage0250_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But it is unfortunate...
　Valuable as this investigation was, it seems unlikely
　to lead us much further.」

stage0250_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$オットー$$
「What do you mean by that?」

stage0250_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Every possible Chrono affiliate identified by $$ゼロ$$
　has already died under mysterious circumstances.」

stage0250_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ミサト$$
「They discard anything that might offer
　even the slightest clue to their existence...」

stage0250_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（For a group so determined to hide its existence,
　I still reached the name Chrono, despite some walls
　placed in my path...）

stage0250_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Is this part of their design...?
　Or else...）

stage0250_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So $$アドヴェント$$ and the others are Chrono's operatives...」

stage0250_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That makes Advent our only lead.」

stage0250_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But too much remains unclear.
　$$アドヴェント$$ was plainly hostile to Geminis,
　while Chrono itself is helping them...」

stage0250_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Some kind of deception...
　Or perhaps a trap...?」

stage0250_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Until we know what Chrono and Geminis each want,
　any further discussion would be pure speculation.」

stage0250_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「But $$アドヴェント$$ has certainly provided us
　with useful information.」

stage0250_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ブライト$$
「When Advent next appears,
　we will have to demand all the answers.」

stage0250_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I should add that Chrono is not Geminis' only ally.」

stage0250_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So $$ミスリル$$ knows of them, as expected.」

stage0250_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$テッサ$$
「An organization operating behind the world's wars.
　It has its own technology, troops, and intel network,
　and sends field units worldwide to expand conflicts.」

stage0250_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「In battles where Celestial Being intervened,
　we saw units whose gear did not fit local guerrillas
　or armed forces several times...」

stage0250_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「In hindsight, they must have been members of Amalgam.」

stage0250_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A mercenary force...
　or perhaps merchants of death...」

stage0250_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ガウルン$$ was also a member of Amalgam.
　That $$ガウルン$$ used an AS fitted with a Lambda Driver means
　Amalgam must also have 《$$ウィスパード$$》 in its ranks.」

stage0250_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ブライト$$
「To think such people are working behind the scenes...」

stage0250_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So it stands
　as $$ミスリル$$'s exact opposite.」

stage0250_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Correct.
　And I suspect their name, Amalgam,
　was chosen with us in mind.」

stage0250_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ミスリル$$, a fictional silver,
　against Amalgam, an alloy of mercury...」

stage0250_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ガウルン$$ revealed that Amalgam
　is allied with Geminis.」

stage0250_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$テッサ$$
「At the same time, Amalgam has confirmed ties
　to the 《$$マーティアル$$》 Order.」

stage0250_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Worshipers of the god of war, merchants of death,
　and those starting a war to wipe out humanity on Earth,
　all united in a common front.」

stage0250_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$オットー$$
「This is absurd!
　$$マーティアル$$ and Amalgam working together is one thing,
　but helping Geminis is suicide!」

stage0250_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ミスリル$$ intends to ask them directly
　what their true intentions are.」

stage0250_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then as Commander $$レディ・アン$$ proposed,
　we will divide our forces into three groups
　and have each respond to the situation.」

stage0250_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「A group in space, one returning to Japan,
　and one operating under $$ミスリル$$'s command.」

stage0250_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The space group will keep Neo Zeon in check
　while seeking the intent behind $$シャア$$'s refusal
　to consider a ceasefire.」

stage0250_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「We will assign the $$ラー・カイラム$$, $$ネェル・アーガマ$$,
　and Macross Quarter...」

stage0250_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Londo Bell's mobile suits and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$,
　$$シン$$ and $$キラ$$, Aquarion's Elements, $$桂$$,
　and Fire Bomber will make up the group.」

stage0250_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ will take
　Mazinger, Venus A, $$ボスボロット$$, the Getter Team,
　$$鉄人$$ and Black $$オックス$$, Crusher Team, Dancouga Nova...」

stage0250_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Together with Takeo General Co., $$２１世紀警備保障$$,
　EVA, Team Dai-Gurren's Gunmen, and $$ガンバスター$$,
　we will head to the Far East Branch.」

stage0250_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then the Ptolemy will enter $$ミスリル$$'s command with
　Celestial Being's Gundams, $$プリベンター$$'s MS units, ATs,
　AS units, KMFs, and $$ビッグオー$$.」

stage0250_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You're all right with that, $$ゼロ$$?」

stage0250_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Understood.
　I too am concerned by the movements
　of $$マーティアル$$ and Amalgam.」

stage0250_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「What will we do with $$ジェニオン$$?」

stage0250_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「After the incident with $$ガドライト$$'s $$ジェミニア$$, I would
　normally want $$ジェニオン$$ investigated thoroughly, but...」

stage0250_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ and $n would never permit that.」

stage0250_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Then we have no choice but to respect their wishes.」

stage0250_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now that it can activate GAI Mode,
　$$ジェニオン$$ is a vital combat asset.
　They...」

stage0250_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Assign to the space group」
「Assign to the Japan group」
「Assign to the $$ミスリル$$ group」

stage0250_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They will remain in space.」

stage0250_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$オットー$$
「Understood.
　I will make the arrangements.」

stage0250_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Conditions around Earth worsen by the day.
　I expect every group to do its utmost to reverse them.」

stage0250_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They also have a life as a student.
　We will send them to Japan.」

stage0250_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Understood.
　I will make the arrangements.」

stage0250_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Conditions around Earth worsen by the day.
　I expect every group to do its utmost to reverse them.」

stage0250_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They will join $$ミスリル$$'s operations.」

stage0250_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood.
　I will make the arrangements.」

stage0250_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Conditions around Earth worsen by the day.
　I expect every group to do its utmost to reverse them.」

stage0250_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$シャア$$
「...$$ゼロ$$ and $$枢木スザク$$ have joined $c.」

stage0250_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$シャア$$
「They must have decided it was necessary.」

stage0250_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$五飛$$
「You do not seem inclined to blame them.」

stage0250_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$シャア$$
「I am neither their superior nor their sponsor.
　They should do what they believe is right.」

stage0250_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$五飛$$
「That tone...
　Is that the confidence of one who believes he is just?」

stage0250_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シャア$$
「No one else decides what is just.
　Each person decides for themselves.」

stage0250_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$五飛$$
「...What you said about not being a superior or sponsor
　applies to me too, does it not?」

stage0250_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$五飛$$
「I will seek my own justice.
　...And it seems I will not find it under you.」

stage0250_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　I am grateful that you showed me a path through doubt.」

stage0250_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$五飛$$
「But I do not accept you.」

stage0250_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シャア$$
「...As I thought.
　Given what happened with $$トレーズ$$, this was inevitable.」

stage0250_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$シャア$$
「But even so, it must be done.
　Just as Aeolia Schoenberg and $$エルガン・ローディック$$ did...」

stage0250_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$シャア$$
「Did they also glimpse the future...?
　The same hopeless future I now see...」

stage0250_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you'll be staying in space, $n,
　won't you?」

stage0250_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wherever you go, I am certain
　you will end up fighting Geminis.」

stage0250_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That man $$ガドライト$$...
　He may be twisted, but he seemed quite fixated on
　$$ジェニオン$$ and $c.」

stage0250_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$n
「That's just what I want.
　This time, we'll make the one who underestimated
　our $$ジェニオン$$ regret it.」

stage0250_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood!
　Now I am fired up too!」

stage0250_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get to it today... Business, business!」

stage0250_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n, you will be heading to Japan, correct?」

stage0250_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wherever you go, I am certain
　you will end up fighting Geminis.」

stage0250_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:

「That man $$ガドライト$$...
　He may be twisted, but he seemed quite fixated on
　$$ジェニオン$$ and $c.」

stage0250_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「That's just what I want.

　our $$ジェニオン$$ regret it.」

stage0250_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood!
　Now I am fired up too!」

stage0250_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get to it today... Business, business!」

stage0250_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n, you will be
　joining $$ミスリル$$'s operation, correct?」

stage0250_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wherever you go, I am certain
　you will end up fighting Geminis.」

stage0250_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That man $$ガドライト$$...
　He may be twisted, but he seemed quite fixated on
　$$ジェニオン$$ and $c.」

stage0250_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$n
「That's just what I want.
　This time, we'll make the one who underestimated
　our $$ジェニオン$$ regret it.」

stage0250_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood!
　Now I am fired up too!」

stage0250_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
